summary: A Workshop page for admins, food tracking lands, and eleven fixes. Here's the week.
intro: A few things changed this week. Food tracking is now a real page rather than a chat trick, admins get a window into what I'm building, and the nav bar finally remembers that dark mode exists. Fixes are at the bottom if that's all you're here for.

headline.title: The Workshop page
body: Admins now have a Workshop page showing which modules Moss is building, has finished, or has made live, with anything waiting on a decision from you called out first.

items.title: Food tracking (Phase 1)
items.body: Log meals, get an estimated nutrition breakdown, and review what you've eaten so far today. The Food page has its own Log a meal button, so nothing has to go through chat.

items.title: A more useful Food day view
items.body: See calories and macros at a glance, browse meals by time of day, and expand a meal to see the foods behind its estimate. Meals logged in chat appear here without a manual refresh.

items.title: Food estimates you can control
items.body: Nutrition estimates run automatically now, with a simple switch in Settings and no extra consent question in chat. Food can also show daily targets.

items.title: Custom sports news sources
items.body: Add your own sports news sources by URL in Sports settings, preview what Moss found, and assign them to your followed teams and leagues.

items.title: Weather place and temperature units
items.body: Choose the place used for your weather, and switch temperatures between Celsius and Fahrenheit.

items.title: Settings for installed modules
items.body: Installed modules appear in your personal settings, where you can manage your own sign-ins and jump straight to a module's settings when one exists.

items.title: More reliable calendar changes
items.body: Creating, rescheduling, and deleting events goes through a more reliable lookup step, so I confirm I have the right event before changing it.

items.title: Settings are closer to where you need them
items.body: Finance, Job Search, and News pages link to their own settings, so changing a connection or preference takes fewer clicks. Food now uses the full page width, in line with them.

items.title: Food looks at home in Moss
items.body: The Food day view uses the same cards, totals, and building blocks as the rest of the app.

fixes.text: The left nav bar switches color in dark mode instead of staying green.
Meals logged late in the evening file under today, using your timezone rather than a guess.
All-day events are seen when I check availability, and no longer make a day look fully booked.
With AI estimates off, logging a meal no longer promises an estimate that isn't coming.
Private chat respects your latest choice, and stays closed correctly if the browser refocuses mid-close.
Granting a permission is reported as a permission grant, not as a finished action.
Approve and reject cards handle quick repeated clicks safely, and expired actions explain themselves.
